areas.power: The laptop will not turn on, or will not charge
areas.network: Problems connecting to Wi-Fi or the internet
areas.performance: The laptop is slow or overheating
areas.storage: The laptop will not start Windows/macOS, or has disk problems
areas.audio_input: Problems with sound, the keyboard or the touchpad

wont_turn_on.text: Does the laptop fail to turn on when you press the power button?

on_battery_only.text: Are you trying to use the laptop without the charger plugged in?

charger_plugged_in.text: Is the charger plugged into both the laptop and the wall socket?

charging_light_off.text: Is the charging light (on the laptop or the charger) off?

socket_works_for_other_devices.text: Does another device (like a phone charger) work in the same wall socket?

lights_or_fan_on.text: When you press the power button, do any lights or the fan come on?

external_monitor_shows_picture.text: If you connect an external monitor, does a picture appear on it?

not_charging.text: Is the battery not charging, even though the laptop is plugged in?

battery_drains_fast.text: Does the battery run out much faster than it used to?

battery_swollen.text: Is the laptop case bulging, or is the touchpad being pushed up?

laptop_over_3_years_old.text: Is the laptop more than 3 years old?

laptop_over_5_years_old.text: Is the laptop more than 5 years old?

faulty_charger.cause: The charger is probably faulty: the wall socket works, but no power reaches the laptop.

faulty_screen.cause: The laptop has power and an external monitor works, so the laptop's own screen or its cable is probably faulty.

worn_out_battery.cause: The battery has lost capacity with age.

swollen_battery.cause: The battery appears to be swollen, which is a fire risk.

recommendations.recommend_charge_battery: Plug in the charger, wait 15 minutes, then try turning the laptop on again.
recommendations.recommend_replace_charger: Try a different compatible charger. If that works, replace the original charger.
recommendations.recommend_screen_repair: Have the screen or display cable repaired by a technician.
recommendations.recommend_consider_new_laptop: The laptop is over 5 years old, so a screen repair may cost more than the laptop is worth. Consider replacing it.
recommendations.recommend_replace_battery: Check the battery health in your system settings and replace the battery if its capacity is low.
recommendations.recommend_stop_using_immediately: Stop using and charging the laptop now, and take it to a repair shop. Do not press on or puncture the battery.
